services.name: Sunday Yoga
services.desc: There’s just something really refreshing and enlightening about vinyasa yoga on a Sunday morning. Which is pretty much the way we feel about beer and bringing people together to create something bigger. That’s why it seemed like too perfect a pairing to bring the two together, and that’s why LauderAle Brewery & Tap Room hosts Sunday beer yoga. We’ve partnered with Ales & Asanas to put on a weekly vinyasa yoga class at our taproom. For one hour, you can let all your worries go, focus on your breathing and on yourself, and get a good stretch in. services.name: Private Events & Reservations
services.desc: Hey, you. Got big plans (for a group of 8 or more)? If you’re going to be throwing a birthday party, leading some team-building exercises, raising money for a rad cause, calling it a career, or even finally tying the knot, we gotchu. You can reserve LauderAle Brewery, the best damn brewery in all of Fort Lauderdale, for your next private event or get-together. Whether you’re reuniting with your old pals from high school or linking up with the whole family for the first time in a while, we’d love for our taproom and beer garden to be your go-to.
